items.headline: OpenAI's Codex into a Super App
items.content: OpenAI is reportedly transforming its Codex coding tool into an all-in-one super app that combines chat, coding, and personal agents, with code leaks suggesting a potential launch as early as next week.

items.headline: OpenAI acquired Multibook, rebranded as OpenClaw
items.content: OpenAI acquired Multibook and rebranded it as OpenClaw, an example of agentic AI that goes beyond content generation to autonomously build workflows or entire websites in minutes.

items.headline: Anthropic launched Claude Managed Agents
items.content: Anthropic launched Claude Managed Agents, enabling no-code creation of custom AI agents that run on their infrastructure, featuring components like harness, session, and orchestrator; this differs from tools like OpenClaw and includes beta integration with Microsoft Office apps like Word.

items.headline: Claude could help businesses achieve 10x productivity gains
items.content: Anthropic's director also discussed in an interview how Claude could help businesses achieve 10x productivity gains.

items.headline: Google unveiled TurboQuant
items.content: Google unveiled TurboQuant, a lossless KV cache compression method achieving 6x memory reduction without data loss, addressing structural memory bottlenecks in large language model (LLM) deployments and potentially easing hardware constraints.

items.headline: Sam Altman's blog post
items.content: Sam Altman published a candid blog post after a Molotov cocktail incident at his home.

items.headline: Mo Gawdat on AI replacing legacy software
items.content: Mo Gawdat's keynote emphasized AI's potential to replace legacy software systems like Oracle or Microsoft SaaS without needing AGI.

items.headline: Neuroscientist Sarah Baldeo on agentic AI's brain impacts
items.content: Neuroscientist Sarah Baldeo noted agentic AI's brain impacts, such as simplifying content creation and data workflows.

items.headline: Google updated Gemini with NotebookLM integration
items.content: Google recently updated Gemini with NotebookLM integration, visualizations, and a new free app called Google AI Edge Eloquent.

items.headline: Anthropic announced a powerful new Claude model described as "terrifying."
items.content: Anthropic announced a powerful new Claude model described as "terrifying."

items.headline: Renesas unveiled a bidirectional 650V-class GaN switch
items.content: Renesas unveiled a bidirectional 650V-class GaN switch for solar inverters and AI data centers (27 March 2026).

items.headline: Advantech and Qualcomm launched the SKY-641E3 server
items.content: Advantech and Qualcomm launched the SKY-641E3 server (27 March 2026).

items.headline: Arm released its first silicon targeting agentic AI
items.content: Arm released its first silicon targeting agentic AI (25 March 2026).

items.headline: GenSpark received a significant update
items.content: GenSpark received a significant update, gaining traction among users switching from OpenClaw.

items.headline: AI is creating new jobs
items.content: Experts note AI is creating jobs like AI training and ethics roles (around 280,000 in the past year) despite disruptions.
